dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.quicksearch.dialog.title>
<!description: Change QuickSearchDialog title from "Quick Text Search" to "Quick Search".>
<!severity: HINT>

$dialog.setTitle("Quick Text Search") :: instanceof($dialog, "org.eclipse.jface.dialogs.Dialog")
=> $dialog.setTitle("Quick Search")
;;
summary: Replaces the specific dialog title "Quick Text Search" with "Quick Search" for instances of `org.eclipse.jface.dialogs.Dialog`.
